item.title: Brisk 0.6.1
item.description:
Requires a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later.

  • Language setting: Brisk is now available in Korean and English. Korean remains the default. To change the language, open Settings > General > Language; Brisk restarts to apply it.
  • Widgets show their content in the selected language.
  • The disk image now includes English installation instructions.

item.title: Brisk 0.6.0
item.description:
Requires a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later.

  • In-app updates: Brisk checks for new versions once a day and installs them on request (Check for Updates in the menu)
  • Keyboard focus moves between the sidebar, article list, and article view with the Left and Right arrow keys; Up and Down scroll the article view
  • Search within the current list (Command-F), per-feed notification toggle, and list actions that are always visible
  • Folders and subscriptions can be reordered and moved by dragging in the sidebar
  • Improved full-text retrieval, plus refresh and memory performance improvements

Earlier versions do not include the updater. Install this version manually once; later versions will be delivered automatically.
